label: Logical falsity, from the self-dependence package at an actual CONCRETE_6 individual
description: Under one interpretation of DependsForBeing (D), CanBeWithout (W), the Profile m and the reading world w (the w₀ of 56f68b40): take an actual concretum x (56f68b40: some CONCRETE_6 candidate exists at w). If D(x,x), the unrestricted dependence-to-grounding bridge 2e248016 makes x ground itself at w, and the actual-world distinct-esse-cause bridge 98efaa9e gives x ≠ x; so ¬D(x,x). Independence allows being-without (8ab3d114) then gives W(x,x), which the meaning postulate 'nothing can be without itself' denies. The five premises cannot all hold; the derivation is constructive (no excluded middle). It certifies lane B's 2026-11-18 package with 98efaa9e; the every-world bridge 402cf70f implies 98efaa9e (separate verified strength step, actualGroundDistinctOfEverywhere), so the package with 402cf70f in its place is inconsistent too, by composing the two results. It does not select a member for rejection. The closed control repairedPackageModel is one Bool/Unit interpretation of a repaired package: the distinct-relata bridge a8298fbd in place of 2e248016, with 8ab3d114, the meaning postulate, 98efaa9e, 402cf70f, an actual concretum and a nonempty strict part of D (true depends on false and not conversely); 2e248016 fails in it. It shows only that this repair is consistent in that interpretation (not a registered model).
